notes.title: Optimizations
notes.content:
Optimizations
1. Reduced skip time for in-game mini-games
2. Reduced difficulty for the Handprint Wiping mini-game in Chapter III.
3. Archery Mini-game in Chapter V: Enlarged the hit area of the giant hand and added the spacebar as a shooting option. Now you can shoot using either the left mouse button or the spacebar simultaneously.
4. Music Game Challenge: Introduced a Normal Mode (7-key), which is now set as the default (song unlocks and achievements are tied to Normal Mode). The challenging "Nether Mode" remains available.
5. Free Music Play Mode: Updated the recommendation from "A keypad is recommended for playing" to "A keyboard is recommended for playing"
Fixes
1. Fixed the inscription error on the back of the stone man in Chapter V.
2. Fixed some translation errors.
